title: Agreement of normalized exceptional locality presentations
statement: Fix the finite purity setting P [def-pur-conventions]. Let v:W→X be separated quasi-compact etale, let h:X→B and q:W→B be separated finite-type compactifiable maps, and let aB:B→Spec(k) be finite type, with q=v h. Then normalizedE(P,v,h,q), defined by exceptional composition followed by rho and the structure-map congruence [lem-pur-difference-first-input-restriction], equals dualizingCongr(q=v h) followed by the uniquely counit-normalized ambient etaleRestriction [lem-pur-diagonal-section-pasting]. Both are isomorphisms from ω_q to Lv*ω_h in the ordinary-etale derived category on W. The equality includes the specified exact-to-derived inverse-image constraint; no section, coordinate, orientation or smoothness is assumed.

proof.text: Eliminate q=v h. Reflexive structure-map congruences are identity. Expand sourceEtale as the exceptional compositor at the coefficient unit followed by rho. The finite etale normalization identifies rho with the unique right mate of the graph-normalized support comparison.

The ambient locality is the right mate of the proper/open compositor followed by the same support/sum comparison. Conjugacy reverses composition, so its inverse has exactly the exceptional-compositor/rho expression. Alternatively compare the two maps after applying the left adjoint and composing with the counit; their transposes coincide, and the adjunction hom equivalence is injective. Evaluate at the coefficient unit, insert the identical exact-to-derived pullback constraint, and restore the structure-map congruence.

theorem normalizedE_eq_etaleRestriction (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    {W X B : Scheme.{u}} (v : W ⟶ X) (h : X ⟶ B) (q : W ⟶ B)
    [Etale v] [IsSeparated v] [QuasiCompact v]
    [IsSeparated h] [LocallyOfFiniteType h] [QuasiCompact h]
    [IsSeparated q] [LocallyOfFiniteType q] [QuasiCompact q]
    [HasCompactification h] [HasCompactification q]
    (hv : q = v ≫ h) (aB : B ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType aB] [QuasiCompact aB] :
    letI := P.noetherian aB
    letI := P.noetherian (h ≫ aB)
    letI := P.noetherian (q ≫ aB)
    letI := P.comparedExponent (𝟙 (Spec (.of P.field.k)))
    letI : HasCompactification (v ≫ h) := HasCompactification.of_eq hv
    ProEtale.DifferenceCoordinateSection.normalizedE P v h q hv aB =
      DiagonalPasting.dualizingCongr P.Coefficient P hv ≪≫
        DiagonalPasting.etaleRestriction P.Coefficient P v h
